text: 本周市场整体倾向是偏积极的，而且这种积极的倾向从周一开始就一直保持着。市场波动率（VIX（衡量市场恐慌情绪，越高越慌），衡量市场恐慌程度的指标，越高越慌）处于中性水平，说明大家没有特别恐慌。收益率曲线（10Y-2Y，反映了长期和短期国债的利率差，正斜率通常表示经济向好）是正斜率但偏平，加上信用利差（Baa-10Y，衡量公司债和国债的利率差，越低说明借钱越容易）偏低，这都暗示着市场融资环境比较宽松，大家借钱投资的意愿比较强。有趣的是，个股之间涨跌的关联度（个股共动，衡量大家是涨跌同步还是各走各的）偏低，说明很多股票是独立表现的，不是大家一起涨或一起跌。本周表现较好的板块是金融和科技，而公用事业、通信服务和能源板块则有所下跌。（这是数据读数不是预测，会错，过去不代表未来）
text_en: This week, the market sentiment was generally positive and this positive trend has continued since Monday. The Volatility Index (VIX, which measures market fear, with higher numbers indicating more fear) is at a neutral level, suggesting people are not particularly panicked. The yield curve (10Y-2Y, which shows the difference between long-term and short-term government bond interest rates; a positive slope usually indicates a good economy) has a positive but flat slope. Combined with narrow credit spreads (Baa-10Y, which measures the difference between corporate bond and government bond interest rates; lower numbers mean it's easier to borrow money), this implies a loose market financing environment, meaning people are more willing to borrow money to invest. Interestingly, the correlation between stock price movements (stock co-movement, which measures whether stocks move up or down together or independently) is low, indicating that many stocks are performing independently, not all rising or falling together. Sectors that performed well this week were financials and technology, while utilities, communication services, and energy sectors saw declines. (These are data observations, not predictions, and can be wrong. Past performance does not guarantee future results.)
caveat: LLM 据本周真实算出因子生成的大白话回顾；喂真数据防瞎编，但仍可能误读。非预测、非荐股、会错，过去≠未来。每周 append 到 llm_weekly_log 公开计分。
